methodology: Binary fields indicate that the current review established the requirement/access feature for the national regime described. A 0 means 'not established by this review', not necessarily a legal absence. EU member states also receive the common Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 manufacturer-reporting layer where that approval route applies. Wider-Europe jurisdictions with unresolved reporting requirements are retained explicitly rather than silently coded as no regulation.

dimensions.label: Mandatory Incident Reporting
dimensions.description: Reports of crashes or other safety incidents submitted to an authority.

dimensions.label: Regular reports
dimensions.description: Recurring safety or operating reports, such as monthly or annual submissions.

dimensions.label: Mandatory VMT Reporting
dimensions.description: Reported mileage or other operating-activity information used to understand exposure.

dimensions.label: Stored event data
dimensions.description: Requirements to record or retain data about safety events. This does not necessarily mean submitting a report.

dimensions.label: Authority access
dimensions.description: Authorities can obtain company or vehicle data, including on request.

dimensions.label: Public / Research Access
dimensions.description: A route to published reports or public/research access. This does not necessarily mean an open crash database.

dimensions.label: Reporting deadlines
dimensions.description: A specified time limit for submitting a report.

dimensions.label: Permit conditions
dimensions.description: Requirements depend on the particular testing permit or operating approval.

dimensions.label: EU approval rules
dimensions.description: The shared EU manufacturer-reporting framework applies when the vehicle uses the covered approval route.

dimensions.label: Open Data
dimensions.description: AV safety or operating data are openly available for public download. Reports obtainable only by request, confidential research access and public summaries are shown separately in country details.

dimensions.label: AVs Authorized
dimensions.description: A legal route permits AV testing or operation, subject to approval and operating conditions. This does not mean every AV company is authorized or unrestricted driverless service is allowed.

policy_elements.label: Mandatory Incident Reporting
policy_elements.description: Companies must report qualifying crashes or safety incidents under the national regime shown. Triggers and deadlines vary by country and permit.

policy_elements.label: Mandatory VMT Reporting
policy_elements.description: Companies must report distance travelled (vehicle miles or kilometres). A requirement to publish a crash rate alone does not count.

policy_elements.label: Open Data
policy_elements.description: AV safety or operating data are openly available for public download. Reports obtainable only by request, confidential research access and public summaries are shown separately in country details.

policy_elements.label: AVs Authorized
policy_elements.description: A legal route permits AV testing or operation, subject to approval and operating conditions. This does not mean every AV company is authorized or unrestricted driverless service is allowed.
